newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Tietmeyer sees no big short-term rate change.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer sees no big short-term rate change.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said that he saw some room for German long-term rates to come down a little, but that there was no room for a significant reduction in short-term rates in the foreseeable future.
The Bundesbank chief, who is in Portugal for celebrations to mark the 150th anniversary of the Bank of Portugal, had been asked to comment on the likely trend of German interest rates.
"For the short-term rates...for the foreseeable future, I don't see any big change," he told journalists after meeting Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Guterres.
"I see some room for moving down a small (amount)," he said, when asked about the prospects for German longer term rates.
